title: New Capabilities for Comprehensive Multimodal Microanalysis in the Inspection and Characterisation of Materials and Components
content: X-ray methods are frequently employed in the inspection and assessment of industrial components and joints, the investigation of industrial accidents and explosions, as well as in the analysis of traffic and aviation accidents, alongside a wide range of forensic analyses. These methods include imaging techniques—such as X-ray transmission and CT, microanalytical methods, including X-ray diffraction (XRD/mXRD), dispersive spectroscopy (EDS/WDS, XRF), and other techniques. These procedures are extensively utilised in forensic analysis for material identification.
